step.details: One tick of the snake engine: a pure function from the previous state to the next, so the game logic is testable without a canvas. It moves the head, grows on food and ends the round on a wall or self hit (the excerpt keeps the move and the eating).

keyToDirection.details: Maps a key press to a snake direction. Arrow keys and WASD both work, and shortcuts with Ctrl, Cmd or Alt held are ignored so the game never steals browser shortcuts.
